system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Beginning at 3rd level you gain access to a reserve of energy called Calories that when spent enable you to perform a series of special abilities and techniques unique to you and your clansmen. You have a number of Calories equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. As you spend calories, you become thinner and less plump, losing fat from around your body. You regain spent calories when you complete a rest.

You can spend these Calories on your chosen Caloric Arts or Hijutsu you know. You gain 2 Caloric Arts when you gain this feature and an additional 2 at 11th level.

Fat Burner

When you cast a jutsu as an Action, that requires hand signs, you can spend Calories to augment that jutsu, allowing you to cast it faster than normal, allowing you to cast it as a Bonus action based on its rank. (D-Rank/C-Rank: 2, B-Rank/A-Rank: 3, S-Rank: 4)

Caloric Burst

As a bonus action, you can spend up to 3 Calories to roll a number of Hit die, equal to the number of calories spent. You regain hit points equal to the result + your constitution modifier. This does not spend your rolled hit die.

Caloric Ignition

As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Calories and consume an Akimichi food pill to enter your Caloric Ignition state. You remain in this state for 1 minute after which, you require 10 minutes to recover before you can reuse it.

Fat Rolls

| #### Caloric Ignition / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Your Unarmed Damage die increase in size by 1 step to a max of d12. / You have a rank of Mastery on Strength based skill and ability checks. / While standing on the ground, you have advantage on checks and saves to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained or Exhausted. |

As a reaction, when you take damage, you can spend up to 4 Calories to redirect your fat to the impacted area, gaining +4 temporary hit points for each calorie spent.

Insular Fat

Elemental conditions are treated as Physical conditions for you. Also, when you would make a saving throw to resist gaining a Physical condition, you can spend 2 Calories to make the saving throw at advantage.

Metabolic Manipulation

At the beginning of your turns, you can spend 2 Calories to reduce the rank of one Physical condition you have by one, that doesn’t have the [Persist] tag.

Retaliating Knuckle Sandwich

While you are within melee range of a hostile creature and they deal damage to an allied creature you can spend 1 Calorie to make an attack of opportunity against them at no reaction cost.

Rolling Shoulders

While moving, you can spend 2 Calories and 10 feet of your remaining movement to push through an enemies space. If you do, they must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest Jutsu save DC, being pushed 10 feet and knocked prone. You can only affect a creature with this effect once per turn.
